notes: Chapter headings are <h2> with Roman numerals I to IX, level 2; the <h1> 'The Great Gatsby by F. Scott Fitzgerald' is level 1. Front matter and the licence section are left out of the heading list.
Anchors: the opening words of chapters I to IX in spine order, plus the book's last paragraph.

headings.text: The Great Gatsby by F. Scott Fitzgerald

anchors: In my younger and more vulnerable years
About halfway between West Egg and New York
There was music from my neighbour’s house
On Sunday morning while church bells rang
When I came home to West Egg that night
About this time an ambitious young reporter
It was when curiosity about Gatsby was at its highest
I couldn’t sleep all night; a foghorn
After two years I remember the rest of that day
So we beat on, boats against the current
